Title: Some users may see outdated activity data in Microsoft Teams usage reports

User impact: Users may see outdated activity data in Microsoft Teams usage reports.

Current status: We've identified an upstream data source has unexpectedly encountered delays, which is resulting in multiple usage reports being outdated. We're repairing the upstream data source pipeline to address the upstream latency issue and can see that the report data is repopulating. We expect the processing of the data will take some time to backfill and we'll continue to monitor the progress to ensure all data becomes up to date.

Scope of impact: This issue may intermittently impact some users attempting to view activity data in Microsoft Teams usage reports. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Root cause: An upstream data source has unexpectedly encountered delays, which is resulting in multiple usage reports being outdated.
